This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] trooper.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was aboard a military hauler-speeder on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when he and three fellow troopers responded to what appeared to be an assault involving [[Myri Antilles]] and [[Voort saBinring]], members of the recently reformed [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]]. After their vehicle landed beside the Wraiths' parked [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], the [[Unidentified Army hauler pilot|pilot]] led their squad toward the pair to intervene while Antilles ran behind him, pretending to seek protection. The trooper then draped his arms around her in a mixed gesture that was half false comfort, half self-gratification.<ref name="MK" />

Moments later, Antilles elbowed him in the solar plexus, causing him to gasp and stagger away from her, before signaling saBinring to drop to the ground. [[Trey Courser]], another member of Wraith Squadron, then emerged from his hiding place inside the Wraith's speeder and [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the other three troopers with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. The trooper who had attempted to comfort Antilles reached for his holstered [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol but was quickly stunned by Antilles with her [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]]. The Wraiths then commandeered the military hauler-speeder as part of their [[Army hauler hijack|mission]].<ref name="MK" />
